bio: Nelson Müller's attractive modern brasserie is an inviting alternative to the fine dining restaurant Schote. Alongside Müller classics such as "Balik salmon Tsar Nikolaj with cucumber "noodles", potato pancakes & buttermilk broth", the top-notch steak cuts and the seasonal three- to five-course set menu are highly recommended. And for those who prefer something a bit more down-to-earth, you can't go wrong with the currywurst or Wiener schnitzel. In fine weather, the pleasant terrace beckons. Given the appealing location in a designated nature area, it's worth staying on at the wonderful boutique hotel Diepeschrather Mühle.
